gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.bezorgguhtje: Rarity: Uncommon (lives in a Scooter Station)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.bezorgguhtje: A mini guh on a scooter with a backpack that's way too big. He lives in a Scooter Station and scoots his round past the Stop Posts: pick up here, drop off there. If the road is blocked, he simply hops right over it. He never loses a thing and always comes back home. Toot toot, nyeg!
block.guhs.vadsmolen.lore: The big sister of the guh windmill: her blades turn on chonk power instead of wind, so she always grinds just as hard. Nibble grain, bones, sugar cane and more. Needs 5 chonk power.
block.guhs.oogster.lore: Mows the ripe crops on the 5 by 5 field in front of his snoot and replants them right away. Needs 8 chonk power. Nyeg, no more bending down!
block.guhs.knabbelaar.lore: Nibbles away the block in front of his snoot, about one every two seconds. He bites as hard as an iron pickaxe, but he politely keeps his teeth off chests, machines and other people's houses. Needs 10 chonk power.
block.guhs.neerzetter.lore: Places the blocks from his tummy one by one in front of his snoot. Seeds and saplings too! Needs 5 chonk power.
block.guhs.knutselmachine.lore: Put a Blueprint in and he tinkers exactly that, from everything that tubes, guhs and you stuff into him. Tick tick tick, done. Needs 10 chonk power.
block.guhs.tekentafel.lore: Lay a recipe on the table, give him a sheet and he draws a Blueprint of it. Drawing costs nothing: you get everything on the table back. No chonk power needed, just a sharp little pencil.
block.guhs.plantagebak.lore: A 3 by 3 box full of dirt. Pop in a sapling or a fungus and within a minute there's a tree. Click the box with an axe and the whole tree comes down in one go. Needs 6 chonk power.
item.guhs.bouwtekening.leeg.lore: Nothing drawn on it yet. Put it on a Drawing Table next to a recipe.
gui.guhs.techmachine.vol: Full! Take out what's inside, then he'll carry on.
gui.guhs.techmachine.mag_niet: He's not allowed to change anything here: this is protected or belongs to someone else. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.techmachine.oogster.veld: Harvests the %s by %s field in front of his snoot
gui.guhs.techmachine.neerzetter.leeg: His tummy is empty: put blocks in
gui.guhs.techmachine.neerzetter.bezet: There's already something in front of his snoot
gui.guhs.techmachine.vadsmolen.leeg: Nothing to grind: put nibble grain in
gui.guhs.techmachine.knutselmachine.geen: No Blueprint: he doesn't know what to tinker
gui.guhs.techmachine.knutselmachine.onbe: He doesn't know this recipe (anymore). Draw it again.
gui.guhs.techmachine.plantagebak.leeg: The box is empty: pop in a sapling or a fungus
gui.guhs.techmachine.plantagebak.wil_nie: %s won't grow. Is there room above the box? Some kinds only grow in fours: then put four in.
gui.guhs.techmachine.plantagebak.boom: The tree is up! Chop it down, or click the box with an axe: then it goes in one go.
gui.guhs.techmachine.scherm.geen_kracht: No chonk power: the little snoot is asleep
gui.guhs.techmachine.scherm.geen_tekenin: Put a Blueprint on the left
gui.guhs.techmachine.scherm.boom: The tree is up! Chop away
gui.guhs.techmachine.tekentafel.leg: Lay a recipe on the grid
gui.guhs.techmachine.tekentafel.onbekend: The table doesn't know this recipe

block.guhs.stepstation.lore: A Delivery Guhling lives here. Give the station 4 chonk power and place Stop Posts (up to 96 blocks away): he delivers everything on his little scooter. Toot toot, nyeg!
block.guhs.haltepaaltje.lore: Place it against a chest or machine and choose: pick up or drop off, and what's allowed along. The Delivery Guhling of the nearest Scooter Station will come by.
item.guhs.bezorgguhtje_fluitje.lore: Whistle and your Delivery Guhling comes scooting over with his backpack open.
item.guhs.bezorgguhtje_fluitje.lore.slui: Whistle while sneaking: all your Delivery Guhlings go home and start over.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.rugzak.dicht: On the road: the backpack is on his back. Wait until he's home, or whistle him over.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.geen_haltes: No stops yet. Place a Stop Post against a chest, within 96 blocks of here.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.ophalen.tooltip: Pick Up: the Delivery Guhling takes stuff out of the chest here, just like a hopper underneath it (so from a furnace only what's done). He only takes along what a drop-off stop really has room for.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.afleveren.tooltip: Drop Off: the Delivery Guhling puts stuff from his backpack into the chest here, on the side where the post stands, just like a hopper (so put the post ON TOP of a furnace to fill it).
gui.guhs.techbezorg.filter.tooltip: Click a slot with an item. All empty = everything may come along.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.ander_station.toolti: Links this post to the next Scooter Station within 96 blocks.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.naar_huis.tooltip: The Delivery Guhling scoots back to the station and starts his round over.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.halte.rij.geen_kist: No chest or machine at this post!
gui.guhs.techbezorg.halte.rij.te_ver: Not loaded or too far away: he skips this stop.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.halte.los: Doesn't belong to a Scooter Station yet
gui.guhs.techbezorg.halte.geen_kist.kort: There's no chest or machine here!
gui.guhs.techbezorg.stand.slaapt: The Delivery Guhling is asleep: the Scooter Station has no chonk power. Zzz, nyeg.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.stand.rust: The Delivery Guhling is resting at the station.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.stand.rijdt: The Delivery Guhling is scooting to stop %s of %s.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.stand.laadt: The Delivery Guhling is rummaging in his backpack at stop %s.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.stand.naar_huis: The Delivery Guhling is scooting home.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.stand.naar_speler: The Delivery Guhling is on his way. Toot toot!
gui.guhs.techbezorg.stand.bij_speler: The Delivery Guhling is waiting with his backpack open.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.stand.zoek: The Delivery Guhling has wandered off for a moment. He'll be back at the station soon, nyeg.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.hover.geen_haltes: No stops: place a Stop Post against a chest (up to 96 blocks away)
gui.guhs.techbezorg.hover.geen_aflever: No drop-off stop: nobody wants the stuff
gui.guhs.techbezorg.hover.vol: The backpack won't empty: it doesn't fit at the drop-off stop. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.techbezorg.halte.gekoppeld: Stop %s of the Scooter Station at %s, %s, %s. Toot toot!
gui.guhs.techbezorg.halte.geen_station: No Scooter Station within 96 blocks. The post will wait until one shows up, nyeg.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.halte.vol: Every Scooter Station nearby already has 8 stops. His little backpack can't handle more!
gui.guhs.techbezorg.halte.geen_kist: There's no chest or machine against this post. The Delivery Guhling skips it.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.halte.mag_niet: This post isn't allowed to reach in here: the chest is in a protected building or in the chore area of someone else's Guh House. The Delivery Guhling skips it, nyeg.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.station.gekoppeld: A Delivery Guhling is moving in! %s Stop Posts nearby now belong to it.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.station.nieuw: A Delivery Guhling is moving in! Now place Stop Posts against your chests.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.fluit.komt: Toot toot! Your Delivery Guhling is on his way.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.fluit.niemand: No Delivery Guhling of yours within 96 blocks. Nyeg?
gui.guhs.techbezorg.fluit.slaapt: Your Delivery Guhling is asleep: his Scooter Station has no chonk power.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.guhtje.dakloos: Nyeg? I'm still looking for a Scooter Station to live in.
gui.guhs.techbezorg.guhtje.lekker: Wahoog! A cheese nibble makes me scoot extra fast.
advancements.guhs.techniek.tech_bezorg_s: Place a Scooter Station and give it chonk power: a Delivery Guhling moves in
advancements.guhs.techniek.tech_bezorg_b: Let your Delivery Guhling bring something from a pick-up stop to a drop-off stop
advancements.guhs.techniek.tech_bezorg_f: Whistle your Delivery Guhling over with the Lighthouse Keeper Guh's Delivery Guhling Whistle
gui.guhs.klus.machines.tip: Collects what's ready in your guh machines (Guh Oven, Tinker Machine, Auto Brewer, Auto Fryer, Chonk Mill, Harvester...) and refills them from the chest. He only refills with what you've shown him: put a little stack in the machine yourself once, and he'll remember what belongs in there. A Tinker Machine gets exactly what's on its Blueprint. This chore is off until you turn it on. Nyeg, after that it works all by itself! (Guhs)
gui.guhs.klus.plantage.tip: Chops down the tree on a Plantation Box with his little axe and brings the wood to the chest. Is a box empty and out of saplings? Then he fetches new ones from the chest. Only in Plantation Boxes: he happily leaves other trees standing. (Guhs)
Machines with something ready to collect: %s
Machines to refill from the chest: %s
Machines that are nearly empty: %s. But the chest has nothing left of what belongs in them
Machines: %s. Nothing to collect or refill right now

a guh machine you placed yourself in the chore area: Guh Oven, Tinker Machine, Auto Brewer, Auto Fryer, Chonk Mill, Grill Coal Press, Harvester, Nibbler, Placer or Slurper. They collect whatever comes out. They refill from the chest next to the house or the Bank Guh, and only with what you've shown them: put a little stack in the machine yourself once, and they'll remember per slot what belongs in there. Putting in something else = remembering something else. The Tinker Machine gets exactly what's on its Blueprint. The chore is off for every resident until you turn it on.
Trees to chop on a Plantation Box: %s
Empty Plantation Boxes that get a sapling from the chest: %s
Empty Plantation Boxes: %s. But there are no saplings in the chest
Plantation Boxes without chonk power: %s. Nothing grows that way, nyeg
Nothing to chop yet. Plantation Boxes with a tree growing: %s

a Plantation Box you placed yourself in the chore area, with chonk power. If there's a tree on it, they chop it down in one go; the box keeps a few saplings itself and plants the next one. If a box is completely empty, they fetch saplings from the chest next to the house or the Bank Guh (satay and sausage fungus, mushrooms and azalea too).
gui.guhs.huisje.opslag.luikje: Stuff from chores goes through the Nom Hatch to your Bank Guh. Nom!
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.ding.hapluikje: No Bank Guh in the chore area? Then your residents bring the stuff from their chores to a Nom Hatch: it noms everything through to its Bank Guh, no matter how far away that is. Only a hatch that works counts here: with chonk power, and linked with the Bank Key to a Bank Guh that's standing somewhere. If that bank is full, the rest goes into the chest.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_machines: I fed a machine. It looked happy. Then it gave me something back. We are colleagues now, nyeg.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.machines: Did you know the machines at %s have a snoot too? I feed them and they make something out of it. That's how I do it myself, only with nibbles.
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_plantage: I chopped down a whole tree with my little axe. In one go! The tree said crack. I said nyeg. And then there was a new little tree already.
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.plantage: Did you know a forest grows in a box at %s? I chop the tree down and the box just makes a new one. It is the smallest forest in the world and it is mine.
